replies.body:
Hey there StefCurry
I am very sorry for the long wait, and I apologize for the amount of patience
you must have had.
There were some complications regarding the evidence, as such, there is effectively
no evidence. As a result, you appeal is accepted and you will be unbanned.

Sorry for any inconvenience, welcome back.
